name: ashgrave-midnight-inquest
description: A multiplayer gothic murder mystery where AI suspects live in Switch rooms (Mattermost).

scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile collab --profile gateway up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile collab --profile gateway down
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile collab --profile gateway logs -f --tail=100
scripts.infra:ps: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile collab --profile gateway ps
